head_coach.name: Miroslav Koubek
head_coach.play_style_summary: Under Miroslav Koubek, Czechia utilizes a direct, physical, and vertical playstyle, focused heavily on coordinated pressing, wing-play with overlapping wing-backs, direct crossing to aerial targets, and set-piece efficiency.

key_players.name: Patrik Schick
key_players.performance_stats: The main attacking focal point for the national team, renowned for his clinical finishing, positioning, and aerial strength in the box.

key_players.name: Pavel Šulc
key_players.performance_stats: In-form creative spark for both Olympique Lyon and Czechia, driving transitions and creating scoring chances from midfield.

key_players.name: Tomáš Souček
key_players.performance_stats: Experienced team leader and defensive anchor, providing aerial dominance in midfield and a constant threat from set-pieces.
